subject: Request: Exec approval for combined credit + discount — NimblyOps POC
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Exec approval for combined credit + discount — NimblyOps POC

Marissa / Ben —

Quick context: NimblyOps (Samir Patel) is a mid-market platform engineering shop evaluating Redwood for an 8-week POC that they want to convert into a production pilot if latency and cost targets are met. Pipeline indicates ~>$120k ARR potential inside 6 months if we win the pilot. They signed the MSA but are asking for a promotional package to tip the decision: 60k free tokens/credits + 25% list discount for the first 90 days, and a 30-day trial extension (total POC length 8 weeks + 30 days). Procurement is asking for pricing to be confirmed by execs before countersigning.

Why this is higher than normal: they plan to run multi-model experiments (chat + embeddings) at scale during the POC; projected consumption could be non-linear. Attachment: NimblyOps_MutualActionPlan.xlsx with usage estimate and rough cost model.

Ask: can we get exec signoff to offer a combined concession (credits + discount + 30d extension) under strict conditions (PO/commit to move to Dedicated / signed SOW or conversion terms within 30 days of POC close)? I estimate the incremental gross cost to Redwood ~ $18k at highest-case consumption. If we instead offer 40k credits + 20% discount, cost is ~ $11k and still compelling against their expected TAM.

Proposed offer variants (for quick decision):
- A (Aggressive): 60k credits + 25% discount + 30d extension — needs exec OK.
- B (Compromise): 45k credits + 20% discount + 30d extension — preferred from margin perspective.
- C (Conservative): 30k credits + 15% discount + 14d extension — fallback.

Please advise direction; if you want me to route to Aditya/leadership for formal approval I can assemble a one-page rationale.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0193
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for combined credit + discount — NimblyOps POC

Aditya — forwarding Rachel's ask. TL;DR: potential $120k ARR account, asking for an unusually large combined concession (credits + discount + extension) to win a fast ramp POC.

My take: good strategic fit (platform engineering shop, likely to buy Dedicated if performance meets SLOs). Risk is consumption spike during experiments. Attached redlines from procurement (POC_TOS_redlines.pdf).

Margin impact estimates: Rachel's model shows high-case $18k cost for the A offer. I think option B (45k credits + 20% discount) is a reasonable middle ground and still compelling to the buyer. We should gate approval on:
- Signed PO within 10 business days of offer acceptance
- Offer limited to Hosted API only (no on-prem / private) during POC
- One-time conversion incentive (discount burns after conversion) — we can discuss renewal economics separately.

If you can greenlight option B I'll draft the external email and the DocuSign. If you prefer option A, list any conditions.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — West Region
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for combined credit + discount — NimblyOps POC

Thanks for the summary and the math. I reviewed the attachment and the projected uplift. Given the strategic fit and the short lead time to revenue, I approve a constrained concession with firm gating. Final approval: OPTION B with the following mandatory conditions — please make these explicit in the offer and DocuSign:

1) Credits capped at 45,000 token-equivalent units (no rollover).
2) One-time 20% discount on invoices for the first 90 days only; discount applies to usage charges, not add-ons.
3) POC limited to Hosted API region us-west-2; no Dedicated or Private usage during POC.
4) Signed PO/statement of work (SOW) or conversion commitment received within 10 business days of offer acceptance, otherwise concessions are rescinded.
5) Procurement redlines in POC_TOS_redlines.pdf must be accepted or countered within the same 10-day window.

Logistics: Rachel — route the DocuSign link to Samir with the above terms; Legal can prep a short amendment to the MSA if procurement insists. Finance will book the promotional cost to 'Sales Promotions Q2 2027' — Ben, please confirm cost center and run the final numbers.

Aditya Rao
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimbleops.com>, NimblyOps Procurement <procurement@nimbleops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for combined credit + discount — NimblyOps POC

Samir — thanks for the productive conversation this morning. We want to move quickly to help you validate Redwood in your environment. Per internal review we are able to offer the following promotional package as a one-time, limited concession: 

- 45,000 token-equivalent credits applied to the POC (no rollover).
- 20% discount on usage invoices for the first 90 days of the POC period.
- 30-day extension on the standard POC timeline (total POC length: 8 weeks + 30 days).

Conditions (please note these are firm):
- The POC will run on Hosted API (us-west-2) only during the promotional period.
- A signed PO or SOW confirming intent to convert to a paid pilot or production deployment must be received within 10 business days of offer acceptance.
- Procurement redlines should be limited to the attached POC_TOS_redlines.pdf; any new material redlines will require review and may void the concession.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/anchor/ABCDEF123456 — this link contains the amendment and the acceptance form. Once countersigned we will provision the credits and apply the discount retroactively to the POC start date.

Samir — if that works, please countersign by 2027-06-21 to secure these terms and route the PO to procurement@redwood.com. If procurement needs any adjustments we can triage, but the concession may need to be scaled back.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
